note: PLAA-related disorder (NDMSBA) is characterized by postnatal onset, progressive microcephaly, spasticity, and leukoencephalopathy/neurodegeneration, distinguishing it from static primary microcephalies.

evidence.text: Seven patients presented at ages 2 to 4 months with progressive microcephaly, spastic quadriparesis, global developmental delay, and leukoencephalopathy associated with loss-of-function variants in PLAA.

source.title: Phospholipase A2-activating protein is associated with a novel form of leukoencephalopathy
source.quote: Herein, we have identified a unique form of leukoencephalopathy in seven patients presenting at ages 2 to 4 months with progressive microcephaly, spastic quadriparesis, and global developmental delay.

numbers.metric: affected patients presenting at 2-4 months with progressive microcephaly and spastic quadriparesis
